# Embedded media

This fixture intentionally contains an iframe without a descriptive title.

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/example" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This iframe has a similarly named attribute, but still lacks an accessible
title.

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/example" data-title="Not an iframe title" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/example" title="" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Titled media

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/example" title="Example video" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/example" title = "Whitespace title" allowfullscreen></iframe>
